name: GCP DNS legacy record set cleanup

statements.__comment__: DEPRECATED: remove in v1.0.0. Record sets written before the GCP DNS data model migration hang off their zone but have no RESOURCE edge from a GCPProject, so the schema cleanup never reaches them. Delete the stale ones in zones that this project owns.
statements.query: MATCH (:GCPProject{id: $PROJECT_ID})-[:RESOURCE]->(:GCPDNSZone)-[:HAS_RECORD]->(n:GCPRecordSet) WHERE n.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG AND NOT (n)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:GCPProject) WITH n LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DETACH DELETE n
